Happy Birthday
to my honey Jessica Sylva Glory Ranteallo

Dari : Fido Maleakhi Mangundap

A message for you

Happy Birthday, My Love. ❤️ Today is not just about celebrating your birthday, but also about being grateful that you were born and that somehow, our paths found each other. I want you to know how lucky I feel to have you in my life. Out of all the people I could have met, I’m grateful that I got to meet you, love you, and share so many moments with you. You are someone I never want to take for granted. I know I may not be the best boyfriend you could ever ask for. I still have many things to learn, many things to improve, and sometimes I may disappoint you without even realizing it. For every moment when I haven’t been the man you deserve, I’m truly sorry. But one thing I can promise you is that I will keep trying. I want to become better not because you asked me to, but because you are someone worth becoming better for. I want to be the kind of man who can make you feel loved, appreciated, respected, and safe. I may not be perfect, but I will keep working to become the best version of myself for you. Thank you for staying, for understanding me, for loving me, and for being a beautiful part of my life. I hope this new chapter of your life brings you happiness, peace, success, and all the beautiful things you deserve. And wherever life takes us, I hope I can still be beside you, supporting you, growing with you, and making more memories together. Happy Birthday, my beautiful girl. I’m truly lucky to have you. I love you, and I’ll keep choosing you today, tomorrow, and in all the days that come after. ❤️

Owner tools

Editor ini bekerja langsung di browser. Untuk perubahan yang ingin dilihat semua orang melalui QR, gunakan tombol Download Updated HTML, lalu upload file hasilnya sebagai index.html ke GitHub Pages.

Edit your website

Penting: GitHub Pages adalah website statis. Karena itu browser tidak boleh menulis langsung ke file GitHub. Tombol Download Updated HTML membuat versi terbaru yang bisa kamu upload ke GitHub sebagai index.html. Jangan masukkan password, token GitHub, atau data pribadi ke dalam file website.
